correctness.rationale: The Frobenius-fixed two intersection points yield ground-field projective normalization. The conic and tangent parameterizations give exact polynomial identity (s-t)^2+t=0, the step u->u-1, unique bad coset F_p, and free sign-pairing of the remaining q/p-1 cosets. Both standalone programs replay and confirm the algebra and representative finite fields. The all-q result follows from proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: This complete invariant for every finite extension sharply separates geometric characteristic-p porism from simple base-field realizability. It classifies all rational p-gons for the natural triple-contact projective orbit, including the surprising prime-field obstruction and exact extension counts. It is a motivated arithmetic enumeration, not a table recomputation or arbitrary slice.
